background_job_state_time_check.name: background_job_state_time_check
background_job_state_time_check.value: ("background_job"."status" = 'queued' and "background_job"."started_at" is null and "background_job"."completed_at" is null and "background_job"."claim_token" is null and "background_job"."lease_expires_at" is null) or ("background_job"."status" = 'running' and "background_job"."started_at" is not null and "background_job"."completed_at" is null and "background_job"."claim_token" is not null and "background_job"."lease_expires_at" is not null) or ("background_job"."status" in ('succeeded', 'failed', 'canceled') and "background_job"."completed_at" is not null and "background_job"."claim_token" is null and "background_job"."lease_expires_at" is null)

evidence_object_domain_student_check.name: evidence_object_domain_student_check
evidence_object_domain_student_check.value: ("evidence_object"."data_domain" = 'knowledge' and "evidence_object"."student_id" is null) or ("evidence_object"."data_domain" = 'student' and "evidence_object"."student_id" is not null)

knowledge_import_attempt_state_check.name: knowledge_import_attempt_state_check
knowledge_import_attempt_state_check.value: ("knowledge_import_attempt"."status" = 'running' and "knowledge_import_attempt"."completed_at" is null and "knowledge_import_attempt"."error_code" is null and "knowledge_import_attempt"."failure_summary" is null) or ("knowledge_import_attempt"."status" = 'succeeded' and "knowledge_import_attempt"."completed_at" is not null and "knowledge_import_attempt"."error_code" is null and "knowledge_import_attempt"."failure_summary" is null and "knowledge_import_attempt"."stage" = 'complete') or ("knowledge_import_attempt"."status" = 'failed' and "knowledge_import_attempt"."completed_at" is not null and "knowledge_import_attempt"."error_code" is not null and "knowledge_import_attempt"."failure_summary" is not null)

knowledge_import_batch_state_check.name: knowledge_import_batch_state_check
knowledge_import_batch_state_check.value: ("knowledge_import_batch"."status" = 'published' and "knowledge_import_batch"."published_at" is not null) or ("knowledge_import_batch"."status" <> 'published' and "knowledge_import_batch"."published_at" is null)

source_document_domain_student_check.name: source_document_domain_student_check
source_document_domain_student_check.value: ("source_document"."data_domain" = 'knowledge' and "source_document"."student_id" is null) or ("source_document"."data_domain" = 'student' and "source_document"."student_id" is not null)
